$comment: Earcon vocabulary — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (spec/40). The bridge maps ids to sounds (M0: generated tones in bridge/audio/speak.py; later: WAV files in bridge/assets/earcons/); H2+ headsets may cache them locally. Sounds ring out to ~1.1 s (except 'timer'), distinct from each other, pleasant at low volume. What's latency-bounded is the earcon *onset* (spec/40: wake→awake < 300 ms), not its length — the ring-out overlaps the next phase.

earcons.meaning: Tier 3 gate: about to do something destructive — say 'confirm' within 8 s to proceed
long answer held; say 'read it' to hear it
something went wrong: a tool action failed (a spoken reason follows) or the pipeline broke (brain unreachable, STT failed)
